Subject: Post-call recap + next steps (integration POC)

Alex / Laura —

Thanks again for a productive call today. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we have alignment: 

- Opportunity summary: 8-week POC to validate document ingestion, embeddings, and a reranking workflow for loan-approval docs.
- Success criteria: 1) 95% precision on redaction/PII flags; 2) <200ms p50 generation for search-assisted Q&A; 3) cost target <$0.12 per 1k tokens during POC.
- POC deliverables (Redwood): SOW draft, sample ingestion plan, sandbox credentials, and a short runbook for test data and KPIs.
- POC deliverables (FinBridge): sample dataset (anonymized), procurement/PO owner, and legal point of contact.

I attached a rough SOW draft for you to scan — it's intentionally short and focused on deliverables and success metrics. Please flag anything missing.

Proposed timeline: kick off next Monday, 3/8 — small sync + env access. If that doesn't work, tell me what dates do.

Attachments: [SOW_Draft_v1.docx]

Next steps (for this thread):
- Rafael to coordinate access and test data needs (cc'd).
- Alex/Laura to confirm procurement/legal contact and priority.

If helpful I can loop in Marissa (legal) early to speed reviews once you send a contract/PO.

Best,
Irene
